Pathweft F3D GLB preview prototype

F3D/libf3d 4.0.0, source b72c7b5c9244e4a0c12975ce6546645c1a8b2680
https://github.com/f3d-app/f3d/tree/b72c7b5c9244e4a0c12975ce6546645c1a8b2680
Copyright F3D contributors / Kitware contributors. BSD-3-Clause.
Full source terms: LICENSE.md.txt and THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md.txt.

The selected C API headers and offscreen-thumbnail example are retained under
reference/ as original text, with hashes in source-manifest.json. Their API and
rendering sequence are adapted in Preview/F3dNative.cs and Preview/F3dViewer.cs.
The C API library is called directly; no F3D executable or shell extension runs.
Only the bundled native GLB reader is selected. The preview uses an owned render
thread and offscreen context, presents frames in WPF, and exposes camera actions.

Native Windows package:
https://github.com/f3d-app/f3d/releases/download/v4.0.0/F3D-4.0.0-Windows-x86_64.zip
Official GitHub asset SHA256:
98E3DB83A0E486D1A5D69F0D10D0B018432E9D200C8FECD0020AFC7DA26AB71E
Selected shared-library and dependency-license inventory: runtime-manifest.json.
The versioned SDK-derived library bundle is a persistent development dependency;
the project build copies its libraries and license files beside Pathweft.
S6 must package those same pinned dependencies and applicable source/license
materials. No application installer, global PATH, file association or shell
registration is changed by the prototype.
